components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-brand-primary); color: var(--color-brand-primary-foreground); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control); padding: 0 var(--spacing-component-lg); min-height: 44px; font: 500 14px/1 Inter, sans-serif; transition: background-color var(--motion-duration-fast) var(--motion-easing-standard); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-brand-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-brand-primary-active); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action with a clear boundary and white surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--color-background-default); color: var(--color-surface-default-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-control); padding: 0 var(--spacing-component-lg); min-height: 44px; font: 500 14px/1 Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-surface-accent); border-color: var(--color-border-hover); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Single-line editable field with semantic focus and invalid states.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: var(--spacing-component-xs) var(--spacing-component-md); color: var(--color-surface-default-foreground); background: var(--color-input-bg); border: 1px solid var(--color-input-border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-input-placeholder); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-hover); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-border-focus); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ring) 20%, transparent); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--color-border-error); } .ds-input:disabled { background: var(--color-surface-muted); color: var(--color-text-disabled); cursor: not-allowed; }

narrative.overview: Enpath's interface is a precise, calm instrument for making career development legible. Information should feel trustworthy and actionable without turning a score into a verdict. Density and hierarchy serve real administrative and employee tasks rather than decoration. The incumbent system pairs crisp white working surfaces with a lightly tinted app canvas, restrained blue brand actions, and carefully differentiated semantic status and information colors. Depth is functional: borders, tonal shifts and deliberate shadows distinguish the page frame, cards and overlays.
keyCharacteristics: White panels on a softly tinted app canvas.
Blue is brand/action; information blue has a distinct meaning.
Reusable semantic tokens govern surfaces, type, spacing and states.

rules.name: The Semantic Role Rule
rules.body: Choose colors by the intent of the semantic token, not by visual similarity between swatches. Never exchange brand, information, destructive and status roles.

rules.name: The No-Hover-Lift Rule
rules.body: Resting cards do not gain raised elevation on hover; elevation communicates a real stacking or interaction condition.

dos: Do use semantic tokens and follow the authority order: token → component → screen.
Do use existing components as documented by their metadata and Storybook stories.
Do use brand blue for brand actions and the information-blue role for information, links and rating-scale steps.
Do make keyboard focus visible and retain accessible names and semantics.
Do preserve touch/pointer control-height pairs and the required target areas.
Do use named text styles; keep Roboto Mono for machine text only.
Do keep the light-mode palette consistent; there is no dark-mode token system.
donts: Don't hardcode token values in components or screens, edit generated tokens.css by hand, or bypass the token-binding guidance.
Don't rebuild an existing component from raw elements or change its semantic role, ARIA, or documented behavior.
Don't use a status color as a generic decoration or treat an AI suggestion as an approved score.
Don't build text styles from ad hoc font, size, weight or line-height utility combinations.
Don't add hover elevation to a resting card or stack multiple visual devices on one boundary without a real structural reason.
Don't invent dark mode or substitute a brand color for the distinct information-blue role.
